### About Our Woodlands Location

Welcome to our newest location in The Woodlands which was designed with a special intent to provide oncologic veterinary care with additional amenities for pet owners, we strive to provide the highest level of care possible while improving your pet’s quality of life during their treatment journey.

Uniquely, we are the first and only specialty referral hospital in the Houston area dedicated to patients and clients with cancer. I found them online and decided to get a referral here because of their great reviews and they did not disappoint. I drive all the way down from The Woodlands, but it is worth it. I am super excited because they have another location opening in The Woodlands 🙂 Highly recommend!!

Susan M

Pet Owner

At the time, no veterinary facility in the region was solely dedicated to oncology care for companion animals.

Dr. Parsons-Doherty has been a Diplomate of the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (Oncology) since 2013. She earned her Doctor of Veterinary Medicine degree from the Atlantic Veterinary College in Prince Edward Island, Canada. She then completed a rotating internship in medicine and surgery at Garden State Veterinary Specialists in New Jersey, followed by a Medical Oncology Internship at the University of Georgia in Athens. She went on to complete her residency in Medical Oncology at Louisiana State University in Baton Rouge.

Following her specialty training in the United States, Dr. Parsons-Doherty joined the Animal Cancer Centre at the Ontario Veterinary College in Canada, where she contributed to both clinical care and education. She was ultimately drawn back to the southern United States and established Houston as her home.

In 2026, Dr. Parsons-Doherty expanded access to advanced oncology care with the opening of a second Animal Cancer & Referral Center location in the Texas Medical Center, alongside the introduction of Radiation Oncology services.

# What makes this different than traditional emergency care?

Unlike a traditional emergency hospitals, our overnight team focuses specifically on oncology patients.

That means your pet receives care from professionals experienced in:

• Chemotherapy complications

• Cancer pain management

• Oncology emergencies

• Cancer-related supportive care

• Oncology hospitalization

Our priority is maintaining continuity of care with your oncology team.

Key Benefits include:

✔ Same oncology team

✔ Oncology-specific expertise

✔ Overnight stabilization

✔ Pain management

✔ Blood transfusions

✔ Fluid therapy

✔ Symptom management

✔ Continuity of care

✔ Communication with your oncologist

✔ Peace of mind

# Why choose ACRC instead of waiting until morning?

When your pet isn’t feeling well, waiting until your scheduled appointment isn’t always the best option.

Rather than wondering if you should go to the emergency room or wait until your primary veterinarian opens, call us first.

You’ll speak with professionals who understand your pet’s cancer diagnosis, treatment plan, and unique needs.

 

### That means:

• Oncology-specific expertise

• Continuity of care

• Communication with your oncology team

• Less repetition

• Familiar faces

• A smoother transition back to your oncologist

# Contact Us At The Animal Cancer & Referral Center

## Need answers?

### Call (832) 669 3800
or
Email us at info@acrc.vet

### We know receiving a diagnosis of cancer for your pet is scary. We are here to help.

We partner with you, as your pet’s advocate, to develop a personalized treatment plan. We understand the bond that you share with your pet, and are committed to providing our very best in care, so you can share your life with your best friend, longer, and to the highest of quality. Every approach we take will be one of compassion and holistic care.
